blurb: Guests can participate in public skating sessions, hockey training programs for various age groups, private skating lessons, and host birthday or group parties at the rink. Hockey programs include team practices, tournaments, and training camps with payment plans available. Birthday and group parties include ice skating time and party room use with options for private or public sessions.
extraNote: 10-pack coupons for freestyle skate available for $180 · Payment plan available for hockey programs with $500 deposit and 6 equal payments · $150 discount for full payment at time of registration for hockey programs · Full payment required prior to birthday party booking; rescheduling allowed based on rink schedule
